Satluj Writer Denies Marketing Stunt Claims Over ZEE5 Takedown

Satluj writer Niren Bhatt has denied claims that the takedown of his film from ZEE5 was a marketing stunt. The film's IMDb rating has also disappeared, sparking confusion among fans. Bhatt attributes the disappearance to a technical issue and assures producers that he wants the film back on the platform.
